app.name: Travether
app.tagline: Find people to do things with on your trip.

landing.titleStart: Find people to do things with
landing.lead: Join travelers who are in the same city, on the same dates, for a hike, a dinner, a day trip, or splitting a ride.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.noId: Takes under a minute. No ID number needed.
signup.aboutHint: Only your first name, age and country are shown to others.
signup.lastNameHint: Private: shown only to people you meet
signup.dobHint: Only your age is shown. You must be 18+.
signup.optional: Optional: a photo and a few interests help other travelers say yes. You can do this later.
signup.acceptTerms: I'm 18 or older and I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms>, the <guidelines>Community guidelines</guidelines> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

home.noTrips: No trips yet. Create a Vacation Card for your trip, or open a friend's invite link.
home.codeHint: Paste the link a friend sent you, or the code at its end.

discover.subtitle: {{dates}} · within {{km}} km
discover.empty: No open plans here on these dates yet. Why not post one?
discover.title: Discover
discover.whereFromHint: Plans are sorted by distance from here. Only the area and a rounded distance are ever shown.
discover.noPlace: Choose where you are to see plans nearby.
discover.noTrip: Add a Vacation Card for your trip to match its dates, or choose a place to browse.

plan.exactAfterApproval: Exact meeting point shown once you're approved
plan.waiting: {{hosts}} will review it. You'll see it here as soon as they answer.
plan.safetyBody: Keep chats in the app until you're comfortable. You can block or report anyone.
plan.cancelBody: Everyone going will see it's off, and open requests close. This can't be undone.
plan.groupsOnlyHint: This plan is for groups: ask with your trip.
plan.needTrip: Create a Vacation Card for your trip first, then ask with it.
plan.bringing_one: Who's coming with you? ({{count}} more seat free)
plan.bringing_other: Who's coming with you? ({{count}} more seats free)
plan.messageHint: Say hi: who you are and what you're into.
plan.request_rejected: This request wasn't approved. You can ask again.
plan.request_expired: This request expired: the plan filled up, started or was cancelled.

trip.previewNote: You're seeing a public preview. Sign up to request to join; the group approves every request.
trip.lenaMessage: Solo in Chiang Mai the same dates. Love hiking!
trip.noPlans: No plans yet. Post the first one: a hike, a dinner, a day trip.
trip.chatHint: Everyone in the trip can read and write here.
trip.deleteBody: The trip, its plans and open join requests will be removed for everyone. This can't be undone.
trip.signUpToJoin: Sign up to request to join
trip.requestPending: Request sent. The group will see it and decide.
trip.requestDeclined: Your last request wasn't approved. You can ask again.
trip.requestIntro: The owner and co-admins see your profile and this note, then approve or decline.
trip.requestMessageHint: Say hi: your dates, what you'd like to do.
trip.handOverBody: {{name}} becomes the owner and you become a co-admin. Only the new owner can undo this.
trip.leaveBody: You'll lose the trip chat and its plans. You can ask to join again later.

share.title: Invite to your trip
share.scan: Scan to view and request to join
share.note: Anyone with the link can see the trip and request to join. You approve every request.
share.newLink: Make a new link (the old one stops working)

create.title: Create
create.planHint: A hike, a dinner, a day trip: what, where and when
create.tripHint: Your trip group: destination, cities and dates
create.meetingPointHint: Search for a place. Only approved participants see the exact spot; others see the area and "~2 km away".
create.audience_open_hint: Solo travelers and other groups can ask for a seat
create.audience_groupsOnly_hint: Only other Vacation Cards can ask to join
create.citiesHint: Used to match you with plans nearby
create.visibility_public: Anyone can find the trip and request to join.
create.visibility_inviteOnly: Only people with the link or QR code can see it.
create.aboutPlaceholder: Who you are and what you're into
create.template_beach_purpose: Which beach, snorkel gear, sunset plans
create.exactHint: The destination is shown only to approved participants.
create.regionalHint: The destination is shown to everyone.
create.bring: Who from your trip is coming?
create.chooseTrip: Which trip is this plan for?
create.noTripsForPlan: Plans live inside a trip. Create a Vacation Card first.

chat.safety: Keep chats here until you're comfortable, and meet in a public place.

profile.title: Profile
profile.ratingRule: The average shows once someone has 3 or more reviews.
profile.next_contactVerified: Confirm your email to get the ✉️ badge. Travelers say yes more often to confirmed profiles.
profile.next_photo: Add a photo so people recognise you at the meeting point.
profile.next_bio: Write a line or two about yourself and how you travel.
profile.next_interests: Pick a few things you like doing.
profile.phoneHint: Private. Never shown on your profile; you can choose to share it in a chat.

settings.title: Settings
settings.quietHours: Quiet hours follow your local time zone.
settings.deleteBody: Your profile, trips and messages will be removed. Reviews you wrote stay, shown as "Deleted user". This can't be undone.

review.askMeta: {{when}} with {{group}}. Only people who both confirm can review each other.
review.report: Something went wrong? Report it privately
review.blindNote: Your review stays hidden until they review you too, or for 14 days, so everyone can be honest.
review.thanksBody: Your reviews will appear once {{names}} review you, or in 14 days.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or it was removed.

auth.logInLead: Welcome back. Use the same method you signed up with.
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth.resetLead: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If {{email}} has an account, a code is on its way.
